g.text: # Celebrity Radar — Shah Rukh Khan
Scams & Impersonation
Financial/deepfake scams (victim: Khan; impersonated):
Jun 2026 — AI‑manipulated video falsely showed Khan promoting an “AI‑based money‑making” platform;
traced to edited footage and flagged as fake (DFRAC).
Jun 2026 — DAU documented copycat scam videos using AI voice clones of Khan (and others) to tout a
financial “investment” project; tools flagged manipulation and recycled scripts (DAU).
Jun 2025 — Composite deepfake splicing Khan with PM Narendra Modi to pitch a “passive income” platform
was debunked; original clips traced to older videos (DAU; The Quint).
2025 — Viral “SRK promotes investment app tied to Ambani” deepfake spread on WhatsApp before debunks
(Mint); another variant alleging “Modi responds to SRK” also flagged as deepfake (Newschecker).
Aug 20, 2024 — AI voice clones of Khan and Priyanka Chopra used in a fake “investment gaming app” promo
(DAU).
Non‑financial impersonation/misinfo (victim: Khan; impersonated):
May 26, 2026 — Deepfake linked Khan to a political jab (“Cockroach Janta Party”); flagged as manipulated
(Newschecker Hindi).
Feb 11, 2026 — Deepfake falsely claimed he backed actor Rajpal Yadav in a legal matter (CyberPeace
Foundation).
Risk assessments and warnings:
2025 — McAfee India’s “Most Dangerous Celebrities: Deepfake Deception List” named Khan among top Indian
celebrities targeted by deepfake scams (ThePrint on McAfee’s 2025 list).
2013–2026 (spikes in 2024–2026) — Fact‑checkers documented recurring scam ads using AI‑cloned celebrity
voices (including Khan) to push get‑rich‑quick schemes and bogus “AI trading,” etc. (BOOM).
Jun 2026 — Threat‑intel advisories warned of broader SRK‑themed AI giveaway/crypto scams and offered
reporting/avoidance guidance (BharatSecure).
Note: Across all above, Khan is the impersonated party; there is no credible evidence he endorsed these
schemes.
